_doc: OPS-SESSION-BUDGET-W1 (cut down by -R2) — every value scripts/session-budget.mjs (the one-wave gate + the compact line) and the installer's session keys read. R2 removed the cold-cache hold and the meter, and with them every key only they read (cold_cache.*, prices, the readout, backfill and skill-census keys); Claude Code's /usage is the scoreboard.
window_reason: autoCompactWindow the installer writes into ~/.claude/settings.json. Auto-compaction fires near window - 33k (measured 466,299-469,623 on a 500k window, 11 events, W1 R0).

dispatch.regex_reason: The spec's [^ ]+ also matches a newline, so a prompt ending one line in .md and the next in Prompt/x.md named a wave spanning both; [^\s]+? stops at the first .md.
dispatch.base_strip_reason: A -V2 or -R2 spec is a later dispatch of the same wave (ruling Q6; Prompt/ held 11 -V2, 1 -V3, 1 -R2 on 2026-10-23).

exempt_prompt_prefixes_reason: UserPromptSubmit fires on these machine turns (measured in ~/.claude/session-log.md: 3,680 / 110 / 59 / 10 / 4 for the five of ruling Q2; then 30 <system-reminder — side-session wake-ups and started-task notices the Desktop app sends — and 2 <<autonomous-loop — /loop wake-ups — found at W1 CH3, 2026-10-23). A machine turn is never classified as a dispatch, whatever dispatch.regex matches, so no edit to the regex can make one refusable. Human-typed shapes that also start with < (<bash-input, <pasted_content, <!-- reply) stay judged.
compact_message_reason: The SessionStart(compact) line is added to context after every compaction; this caps it.
hook_timeout_reason: The installer writes this as the timeout of the UserPromptSubmit and SessionStart(compact) registrations, so a hung hook delays a prompt by at most this long instead of the hook default.
files_reason: OPS-STATUS-INDEX-LEDGER-W1: byte caps on the vault files every session reads. ops/scripts/status-append.mjs refuses (OVER) a status.md write over its cap and its --report prints all three. status.md = trim-status-config max_bytes. AOE-status.md and CLAUDE.md are pinned at their measured size on 2026-10-23, so growth shows in --report. scripts/session-budget.mjs does not read this key.
